title.zh: Gold v2 依赖安全同步

purpose.en: Synchronize the patched fflate dependency identified while validating the shared SmartPay5 rollout.
purpose.zh: 同步共享 SmartPay5 发布验证中发现的 fflate 依赖安全修复。

en: Pin fflate 0.8.3 to remove GHSA-px8p-9vwx-vf98 from the production dependency graph.
zh: 锁定 fflate 0.8.3，从生产依赖图中移除 GHSA-px8p-9vwx-vf98。

en: Dependency resolution, lockfile, and the exact release record only.
zh: 仅影响依赖解析、锁定文件和精确发布记录。

en: Add an exact transitive dependency override without changing SmartLingo application behavior.
zh: 新增精确的间接依赖覆盖，不改变 SmartLingo 应用行为。

en: Require zero npm audit vulnerabilities, all repository gates, exact deployment, production probes, and matching private Project evidence; interactive browser testing is intentionally omitted for this portfolio sync.
zh: 要求 npm 审计零漏洞、全部仓库门禁、精确部署、生产探测及匹配的私有 Project 证据；本次组合同步按要求不做交互式浏览器测试。

en: No feature, database schema, contract, product, price, provider setting, or production data changes.
zh: 不修改功能、数据库架构、合约、产品、价格、服务商设置或生产数据。

en: Preserve SmartLingo branding, language-learning products, Clerk, RealtimeKit, SmartPay5, referral, certificate, header, footer, and independent infrastructure boundaries.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 品牌、语言学习产品、Clerk、RealtimeKit、SmartPay5、推荐、证书、页眉页脚及独立基础设施边界。

rollback.en: No data migration is included; roll back only this dependency release if required.
rollback.zh: 不包含数据迁移；如有需要，仅回滚本次依赖发布。
